SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - not part of the evaluation corpus

RESIDENTIAL RENTAL AGREEMENT

1. PARTIES AND PREMISES. This Residential Rental Agreement is entered into between the Landlord and the Tenant for the residential premises at Sector 14, Chandigarh.

2. TERM AND LOCK-IN. The tenancy shall run for 11 months commencing on 1 January 2027.

2.1 Lock-in Period: Neither the Landlord nor the Tenant may terminate during the initial 6-month lock-in period.

2.2 Renewal Option: Upon expiry, the parties may renew the rental agreement in writing.

3. RENT AND DEPOSIT. All payments are due on or before the 5th day of each calendar month.

3.1 Monthly Rent: The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 22,000 via bank transfer.

3.1.1 Maintenance Charges: Society maintenance charges of Rs. 2,000 per month shall be borne by the Tenant.

3.2 Security Deposit and Late Fees: The Tenant has placed an interest-free security deposit of Rs. 44,000 subject to:
(a) Late rent beyond the 10th day incurs a penalty of Rs. 500 per day.
(b) Deductions from the security deposit are allowed only for:
(i) Unpaid rent or pending utility bills at handover.
(ii) Repair of structural damage beyond normal wear and tear.

Clause 4: Subletting Restrictions. The Tenant shall not sublet, assign, or transfer possession of the premises without written consent.

Section 5: Notice to Vacate. Either party must give 30 days' prior written notice after the lock-in period to vacate the premises.

GOVERNING LAW AND EVICTION
Breach of essential obligations may entitle the Landlord to initiate eviction proceedings under applicable state tenancy law.
